plugins.releaseBodyTemplate:
**macOS** (Apple silicon): open the `.dmg` and drag Heron to Applications. Heron isn't notarized yet, so macOS blocks the first open: click Done, then System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway.

**Windows** 10 or 11 (x64): run the installer. It installs for your user only, with no admin prompt. It's unsigned, so SmartScreen warns the first time: More info → Run anyway.

Heron needs `git`, `gh` and `claude` installed and logged in. On launch it checks all three and shows how to fix anything missing. Once installed, Heron updates itself: Windows installs new versions when you quit or restart Heron, and macOS downloads them and opens the installer when you choose Install update. See the [README](https://github.com/max-d3v/heron#get-started).
